text:
Based on the onboarding guide, this error occurs because Azure OpenAI requires an API version query parameter in the endpoint URL. 

### Solution / Workaround:
1. **Include `?api-version=...` in your endpoint URL:**
   Update your endpoint configuration to include the required Azure API version. Hermes will automatically preserve and forward these query parameters:
   ```text
   https://<your-resource-name>.openai.azure.com/openai/deployments/<your-deployment-name>/chat/completions?api-version=2024-02-15-preview
   ```
   *(Replace `2024-02-15-preview` with your target Azure OpenAI API version).*

2. **Verify Deployment Name:**
   Ensure the deployment name in the URL path (`gpt5.4` in your logs) exactly matches the deployment name configured in your Azure OpenAI resource.
